description: Holds one room (an offer_id from search_hotels or get_hotel) with the partner for the named guest and returns booking_id, booking_secret (shown once), the confirmed total (price_changed and previous_total when the hotel repriced it), the cancellation terms and pay_url. Nothing is ever charged by a tool: the person named as guest pays on the pay_url page, Nuitee's payment form, and the booking exists only after that payment. Give the guest pay_url and tell them the total and the cancellation terms; if price_changed is true, say so. The guest's name must match the ID shown at check-in; email and phone with country code are required. Send an idempotency_key to make a retry safe. Needs a Quub API key (this connection has none yet: use request_api_key).

adults.description: Adults in the one room, 1 to 8. Default 2.

checkin.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later.

checkout.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD, 1 to 30 nights after check-in.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for the prices, default EUR.

expected_total.description: The total you saw for this offer, so a change is flagged.

guest_email.description: The confirmation goes here; the guest needs it to cancel.

guest_first_name.description: As on the ID shown at check-in.

guest_last_name.description: As on the ID shown at check-in.

hotel_id.description: The hotel id the offer belongs to.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string; the same key returns the same booking instead of a second one.

nationality.description: Guest nationality, ISO 3166 alpha-2 (prices can depend on it). Default from the client's language, else NL.

offer_id.description: offer_id from search_hotels or get_hotel, for these dates and adults.

remarks.description: Special requests for the hotel, not guaranteed.

name: prebook
title: Prebook a room
